<?php
require '/wordpress/wp-load.php';

update_option('woocommerce_coming_soon', 'no');
update_option('woocommerce_store_pages_only', 'no');
update_option('woocommerce_default_country', 'GB');
update_option('woocommerce_currency', 'GBP');
update_option('woocommerce_enable_guest_checkout', 'yes');
update_option('woocommerce_calc_taxes', 'no');
update_option('woocommerce_cod_settings', array('enabled' => 'yes', 'title' => 'Cash on delivery', 'description' => 'Pay when it arrives.', 'enable_for_methods' => array(), 'enable_for_virtual' => 'yes'));
update_option('woocommerce_bacs_settings', array('enabled' => 'no'));
update_option('woocommerce_cheque_settings', array('enabled' => 'no'));

$zone = new WC_Shipping_Zone(0);
$zone->add_shipping_method('free_shipping');
$zone->save();

$mug = new WC_Product_Variable();
$mug->set_name('Morning mug');
$mug->set_slug('morning-mug');
$mug->set_sku('HF-MUG');
$mug->set_description('A 350 ml mug with a wide handle, glazed inside and out.');
$mug->set_status('publish');
$attribute = new WC_Product_Attribute();
$attribute->set_name('Glaze');
$attribute->set_options(array('Moss', 'Oat', 'Ash'));
$attribute->set_position(0);
$attribute->set_visible(true);
$attribute->set_variation(true);
$mug->set_attributes(array($attribute));
$mug->save();
foreach (array('Moss' => 24, 'Oat' => 18, 'Ash' => 0) as $glaze => $stock) {
  $variation = new WC_Product_Variation();
  $variation->set_parent_id($mug->get_id());
  $variation->set_attributes(array('glaze' => $glaze));
  $variation->set_sku('HF-MUG-' . strtoupper($glaze));
  $variation->set_regular_price('29.00');
  $variation->set_manage_stock(true);
  $variation->set_stock_quantity($stock);
  $variation->set_stock_status($stock > 0 ? 'instock' : 'outofstock');
  $variation->set_status('publish');
  $variation->save();
}
WC_Product_Variable::sync($mug->get_id());

$bowl = new WC_Product_Simple();
$bowl->set_name('Pasta bowl');
$bowl->set_slug('pasta-bowl');
$bowl->set_sku('HF-PASTA');
$bowl->set_description('A shallow 22 cm bowl for pasta, salads and stews.');
$bowl->set_regular_price('34.00');
$bowl->set_manage_stock(true);
$bowl->set_stock_quantity(30);
$bowl->set_status('publish');
$bowl->save();

flush_rewrite_rules(true);
